about: Enclosures: sash, fan, light, uv, mode, cycle (antechamber), read, open/close (antechamber doors), status. power, ack, estop come from the shared layer.

fan.hint: the blower runs with the gas purification (`chemlab run INST start` / `stop`); give a speed, e.g. `fan 60%`.
notes: the speed applies while the gas purification runs (`start`); with high O2 the blower may run at 100 % (O2 speed)

cycle.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.
cycle.label: power on

cycle.message: the outer antechamber door of {inst} is open.
cycle.label: outer door closed

cycle.message: the inner antechamber door of {inst} is open.
cycle.label: inner door closed

cycle.message: an antechamber cycle is already running on {inst}.
cycle.label: no cycle running

open.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.
open.label: power on

fan:speed.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.
fan:speed.label: power on

unsupported.sash: a closed glovebox: no sash (items go in through the antechamber: `open outer`, `cycle`, `open inner`)
unsupported.mode: no operating modes; the gas purification is `start` / `stop` (gas_fluid)

open: doors: outer (to the room) and inner (to the box); the inner door opens only after the antechamber was cycled since the outer door was opened
cycle: each cycle evacuates the antechamber and refills it with inert gas; `cycle --cycles 3 --wait` runs three and waits; without --wait you get job-N

other.maintenance: maintenance mode needs the admin PIN in the menu (`chemlab call INST menu.enter --pin ...`, then mode.set)

sash.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.
sash.label: power on

sash.message: {inst} is in standby: the sash does not move.
sash.fix: switch the fan on: `chemlab run {inst} fan on`.
sash.label: not in standby

fan:on.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.
fan:on.label: power on

fan:on.message: the sash of {inst} is closed; the blower runs only with the sash at a working height.
fan:on.fix: raise it first: `chemlab run {inst} sash safe`.
fan:on.label: sash open

fan:off.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.
fan:off.label: power on

fan:standby.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.
fan:standby.label: power on

light:on.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.
light:on.label: power on

light:on.message: the sash of {inst} is closed; the light works only with the sash open.
light:on.label: sash open

light:off.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.
light:off.label: power on

uv:on.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.
uv:on.label: power on

uv:on.message: the UV lamp of {inst} works only with the sash fully closed (now {value}).
uv:on.label: sash closed

uv:on.message: the blower of {inst} is {value}; the UV lamp works only with the blower off.
uv:on.fix: switch it off and let the post-purge end: `chemlab run {inst} fan off`.
uv:on.label: blower off

uv:off.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.
uv:off.label: power on

mode.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.
mode.label: power on

mode.message: the mode of {inst} is changed only while it runs normally (fan {value}).
mode.fix: switch the fan on and wait for the warm-up: `chemlab run {inst} fan on --wait`.
mode.label: fan on

unsupported.cycle: no antechamber or decontamination cycle from the computer

sash: positions: close (UV mode), safe (175 mm working height), open (470 mm, cleaning; alarms while the blower runs); the motor moves stop by stop and the verb waits
fan: fan on starts the warm-up (about 3 min); --wait waits until the airflow is OK
uv: UV only with the sash closed and the blower off; lifting the sash switches it off

sash: positions: close, safe (457 mm, the sash stop and working height), open (670 mm; above the stop only with --hold)
mode: mode night tells the airflow monitor that the sash is closed for the night (night setback); mode normal ends it
